content.short: Neutral is a marketplace where allocators source quant strategies and traders raise capital.
content.description: Neutral connects two sides that usually meet through private channels: allocators looking for quantitative strategies, and traders looking for capital, with the strategies running as institutional-grade on-chain vaults. It operates on Monad and Robinhood Chain. Putting the track record on-chain is the part that changes the relationship, since performance becomes verifiable rather than reported.
